debugger.meteor.title: .NET Meteor Debugger
debugger.meteor.description: A new configuration for launching .NET apps.
configuration.androidPort: Android's default port of the CoreClr debugger.
configuration.applePort: iOS's default port of the CoreClr debugger.
configuration.hotReloadHostPort: The port of the Hot Reload server.
configuration.uninstallApplicationBefore: Uninstalls the application before installing it again.
configuration.applyHotReloadChangesOnSav: Controls whether the Hot Reload server should apply changes automatically on document save.
configuration.remoteCoreclrTarget: Path to the VsdbgRemoteCoreclrTarget folder bundled with the Microsoft .NET MAUI extension.
configuration.remoteCoreclrHost: Path to the VsdbgRemoteCoreclrHost folder bundled with the Microsoft .NET MAUI extension.
